content:
alex: CI red on main: failing test in runtime::serve::retry::backoff_boundaries
alex: test name `bind_race_with_backoff` — failing ~1/20 runs locally too
ci-bot: job https://ci.internal.redwood/rows/98765 failed on ubuntu-22 with exit 1 (flaky). logs: /artifacts/98765/log.txt
priya: ugh, saw this pop up in nightly as well. stack shows assertion in `prefetch_queue.rs:142`
sam: can you paste the failing assert? helps to see exact condition
alex: sure — from the log:
```
thread 'test_bind_race_with_backoff' panicked at 'expected len <= 1, got 3', prefetch_queue.rs:142:9
```
alex: seems like a race where multiple in-flight prefetches for same key aren't collapsed
maria: do we have a quick reproducer? tried `cargo test --test serve -- --nocapture bind_race_with_backoff` and couldn't repro after 50 runs
alex: local repro command that got it for me:
```
RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 RUST_BACKTRACE=1 cargo test serve::retry::bind_race_with_backoff -- --exact --nocapture --test-threads=1
for i in {1..200}; do ./target/debug/deps/serve_test --exact bind_race_with_backoff && echo ok || echo fail_$i; done
```
alex: triggered ~1/20 with that loop
priya: can someone kick a rerun on the failing CI row? maybe grab full coredump if present
ben: rerun kicked: https://ci.internal.redwood/rows/98765/retry -> status: queued :hourglass:
sam: short hypothesis: backoff timer jitter + shared cache prefetch path not holding the collapse lock long enough, so multiple prefetch tasks enqueue
maria: if that's true, adding a quick check to assert no duplicate keys in the pending map before popping would help catch earlier. but might hide root cause
priya: agree. instead can we capture a snapshot when assert triggers (dump pending keys + timestamps) to S3? less intrusive
alex: i can add a tiny debug dump guarded by env var `SERVE_BINDRACE_DUMP=1` and push a small PR, then rerun CI
sam: also assign bisect if rerun stays flaky — maybe add `--histogram-seed` sweep to see sensitivity
ben: rerun started on new row 98766
ci-bot: row 98766 failed (same assert). attached full log: /artifacts/98766/log.txt
maria: thanks — alex, when you push the dump PR, can you include a small reproduction harness that spawns >8 concurrent bind attempts? that should amplify the race
alex: will do, aim to open PR in next hour and ping here for CI rerun. tagging @priya for review if small impl changes needed
priya: happy to review. if it's messy, sam can help with locking strategy
sam: ping me after PR, I'll run full local sweep on metal (longer runtime) to try to reproduce deterministically
ben: adding note to issue #1423 to track — labeling flaky:test and priority:high
alex: thanks all, will update here once PR is up :thumbsup:
